# MindStick

> MindStick is a custom software development company offering end-to-end solutions in web, mobile, cloud, AI, and enterprise software across multiple technology stacks.

MindStick provides comprehensive software development services spanning modern technologies including .NET, Java, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), mobile development (iOS, Android, React Native), and emerging technologies like AI/ML and blockchain. The company serves enterprise clients globally with expertise in custom software, web applications, mobile apps, DevOps, and digital marketing services.

## Key Topics

- Custom Software Development
- Web Development
- Mobile App Development
- Cloud Development
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Enterprise Solutions
- .NET & ASP.NET
- Microsoft Azure
- iOS & Android
- DevOps
- Blockchain Technology
- Data Science
- ERP Software
- CRM Development
- Digital Marketing

## Development Services

- [Web Development](https://www.mindstick.com/services/web-development): Web development: Java, JavaScript, full-stack, corporate websites in India
- [Mobile App Development](https://www.mindstick.com/services/mobile-app-development): Mobile apps: iOS, Android, React Native, cross-platform, AI-powered apps
- [Cloud Application Development](https://www.mindstick.com/services/cloud-development): Cloud development: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Docker, SaaS, containerization
- [Windows Development](https://www.mindstick.com/services/windows-development): Windows app development: Windows Phone, PhoneGap, custom applications
- [UI/UX Development](https://www.mindstick.com/services/ui-ux-development): UI/UX design: AR, Material Design, iOS/Android design, user experience
